message.content:
This editorial illustration, titled "TEMPO" with the subtitle "50 Tahun!" and "EDISI IDUL FITRI," features a centered figure sitting cross-legged. This man, wearing a white skullcap and a light-colored t-shirt, is shown from a three-quarter view. His arms are covered in intricate dark geometric tattoos. He looks down at an open book held on a low wooden bookstand. The book emits a bright white glow, illuminating his face, hands, and chest. The man sits in a dark space, with a grid of bright light and dark shadows cast over him, suggesting light coming through a barred window.

The background is a dark, textured gray. Large white text to the right reads "PERTOBATAN DI PENJARA," followed by a paragraph of smaller white text. In the lower-left corner, there is a date "17-23 MEI 2021," a price "RP 45.000," and a barcode with numbers. The man's hands gently hold the edges of the glowing book. The composition is vertically oriented, with the figure positioned in the lower two-thirds of the frame.
